text:
Hello !

J'ai reçu cette offre sur LinkedIn :

"Imagine this: you’re the architect of a growth engine that takes a startup from its _first sparks of traction_ to a roaring blaze. You’re not inheriting a system — you’re designing it. From the playbooks to the pixels, from the brand voice to the dashboards, you set the tone for what “marketing” means at Guideflow.

They’ve just closed a €1.5M seed round and are gearing up for our Series A. Now we’re looking for our Founding Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS) — someone hands-on enough to run campaigns solo today, but strategic enough to build the team and structure for tomorrow.

The mission:
 Turn a €20–30k monthly budget into a repeatable, data-driven growth loop across paid, organic, and content channels. Within six months, your experiments and insights should make us say, “Yep, this is working — now let’s scale it.”

Your playground:
• Build and optimize Google, LinkedIn, and Meta campaigns that convert clicks into qualified pipeline. 
• Shape our SEO and content engine from the ground up. 
• Define our brand story and tone for Guideflow 2.0. 
• Treat every channel as an experiment — measure, iterate, repeat. 
• Partner with Sales & Product to make sure marketing isn’t just loud, but effective. 
What “good” looks like:
 You’ve lived through the 1 → 10M ARR climb. You love numbers but also know how to tell a story that sells. You’ve been scrappy, strategic, and seen chaos turn into clarity.

The details:
:round_pushpin: Paris preferred (or remote within France — with occasional in-person collaboration)
:moneybag: €60–75k base + 0.5–0.7% equity + bonus
:speaking_head_in_silhouette: English fluency required (French a plus)"

Si vous connaissez quelqu'un d'intéressé, n'hésitez pas à contacter <https://www.linkedin.com/in/neilcollierrecruiter/|Neil Collier> qui s'occupe du recrutement !
